---
title: "Stage 3f: NTD Operating Expenses – unified agency-year panel 2014-2024"
---

```{r}
#| label: purpose
#| include: false
# =============================================================================
# Purpose : Build a tidy agency-year panel of NTD total operating expenditure.
# Sources :
#   2014-2021: data/raw/ntd/operating_expenses_YYYY.xlsx
#   2022-2024: data/raw/ntd/ntd_operating_socrata_raw.csv (Socrata i5ki-dc58)
# Output  : data/cleaned/ntd_operating.rds
#   Columns: ntd_id, agency_name, city, state, year, total_operating_usd
# =============================================================================
```

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(here)
here::i_am("_quarto.yml")
```

## Read 2014-2021 xlsx files

```{r}
#| label: xlsx
# Column-name normalization. Operating-expenses xlsx files vary across years
# (2014 has "5 Digit NTDID" + "Reporter Name"; 2017+ has "NTD ID" + "Agency
# Name"). The "Total Operating Expenses" column is consistently present (with
# slight casing/spacing variation handled by janitor::clean_names).
pick_first <- function(df, candidates) {
  for (c in candidates) if (c %in% names(df)) return(df[[c]])
  rep(NA_character_, nrow(df))
}

read_xlsx_year <- function(yr) {
  f <- here("data", "raw", "ntd", sprintf("operating_expenses_%d.xlsx", yr))
  if (!file.exists(f)) return(tibble())
  sheets <- excel_sheets(f)
  # Sheet name is "Operating Expense" (2014) or "Operating Expenses" (2017+)
  sheet <- sheets[str_detect(sheets, regex("operating.?expense", ignore_case = TRUE))][1]
  if (is.na(sheet)) sheet <- sheets[1]
  d <- read_excel(f, sheet = sheet) |> janitor::clean_names()

  tibble(
    year                = yr,
    ntd_id              = as.character(pick_first(d, c("ntd_id", "x5_digit_ntdid"))),
    legacy_ntd_id       = as.character(pick_first(d, c("legacy_ntd_id", "x4_digit_ntdid"))),
    agency_name         = as.character(pick_first(d, c("agency_name", "reporter_name"))),
    total_operating_usd = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(pick_first(d,
                            c("total_operating_expenses",
                              "total_operating_expenses_no_funds_reported_separately"))))
  ) |>
    filter(!is.na(total_operating_usd), total_operating_usd > 0) |>
    group_by(year, ntd_id, legacy_ntd_id, agency_name) |>
    summarise(total_operating_usd = sum(total_operating_usd), .groups = "drop")
}

ntd_xlsx <- map_dfr(2014:2021, read_xlsx_year)
cat("xlsx years loaded:", paste(sort(unique(ntd_xlsx$year)), collapse=", "), "\n")
cat("xlsx agency-year rows:", nrow(ntd_xlsx), "\n")
```

## Read 2022-2024 Socrata CSV

```{r}
#| label: socrata
# i5ki-dc58 is a pre-aggregated agency-year view: one row per agency per year
# with a `Total` column.
so <- read_csv(here("data", "raw", "ntd", "ntd_operating_socrata_raw.csv"),
               show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  janitor::clean_names()

ntd_socrata <- so |>
  transmute(
    year                = as.integer(report_year),
    ntd_id              = as.character(ntd_id),
    agency_name         = as.character(agency),
    city                = as.character(city),
    state               = as.character(state),
    total_operating_usd = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(total))
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(total_operating_usd), total_operating_usd > 0)

cat("Socrata years loaded:", paste(sort(unique(ntd_socrata$year)), collapse=", "), "\n")
cat("Socrata agency-year rows:", nrow(ntd_socrata), "\n")
```

## Attach city/state to pre-2022 rows via NTD ID crosswalk

```{r}
#| label: crosswalk
# Build an ntd_id ↔ legacy_ntd_id map from rows that have both, then use the
# Socrata 2022-2024 file as the authority on city/state.
legacy_xwalk <- ntd_xlsx |>
  filter(!is.na(ntd_id), !is.na(legacy_ntd_id)) |>
  distinct(ntd_id, legacy_ntd_id) |>
  group_by(legacy_ntd_id) |> slice(1) |> ungroup()

ntd_xlsx <- ntd_xlsx |>
  left_join(legacy_xwalk |> rename(ntd_id_from_legacy = ntd_id),
            by = "legacy_ntd_id") |>
  mutate(ntd_id = coalesce(ntd_id, ntd_id_from_legacy)) |>
  select(-ntd_id_from_legacy)

crosswalk <- ntd_socrata |>
  distinct(ntd_id, agency_name, city, state) |>
  group_by(ntd_id) |> slice(1) |> ungroup()

ntd_xlsx2 <- ntd_xlsx |>
  left_join(crosswalk |> select(ntd_id, city_cw = city, state_cw = state),
            by = "ntd_id") |>
  mutate(city = city_cw, state = state_cw) |>
  select(year, ntd_id, agency_name, city, state, total_operating_usd)

cat("Pre-2022 rows with city matched via crosswalk:",
    sum(!is.na(ntd_xlsx2$city)), "of", nrow(ntd_xlsx2), "\n")
```

## Combine

```{r}
#| label: combine
ntd_op <- bind_rows(
  ntd_xlsx2,
  ntd_socrata |> select(year, ntd_id, agency_name, city, state, total_operating_usd)
) |>
  arrange(year, ntd_id)

cat("Full operating panel – rows by year:\n")
print(ntd_op |> count(year))
cat("\nUnique agencies:", n_distinct(ntd_op$ntd_id), "\n")
cat("Rows with city/state:", sum(!is.na(ntd_op$city) & !is.na(ntd_op$state)),
    "/", nrow(ntd_op), "\n")
```

## Cross-check vs capital

```{r}
#| label: cross-check
ntd_cap <- readRDS(here("data", "cleaned", "ntd_transit.rds"))
ratio <- ntd_op |>
  inner_join(ntd_cap |> select(year, ntd_id, total_capital_usd),
             by = c("year", "ntd_id")) |>
  mutate(op_to_cap_ratio = total_operating_usd / pmax(total_capital_usd, 1))

cat(sprintf("Agency-years with both capital and operating reported: %d\n", nrow(ratio)))
cat(sprintf("Median operating/capital ratio: %.2f\n", median(ratio$op_to_cap_ratio, na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("Quartiles of operating/capital ratio: %s\n",
            paste(round(quantile(ratio$op_to_cap_ratio, c(.25, .5, .75), na.rm = TRUE), 2),
                  collapse = " / ")))
```

## Write

```{r}
#| label: write
out <- here("data", "cleaned", "ntd_operating.rds")
saveRDS(ntd_op, out)
cat(sprintf("Wrote %s – %d rows\n", out, nrow(ntd_op)))
```
